answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The system stays honest because reputation is unforgeable and only earned through accepted attestations, so freshly minted aliases genuinely cannot swing a verdict.
